class.name: SkeletonModifier3D
class.brief_description: A node that may modify a Skeleton3D's bones.
class.description: [SkeletonModifier3D] retrieves a target [Skeleton3D] by having a [Skeleton3D] parent. If there is an [AnimationMixer], a modification always performs after playback process of the [AnimationMixer]. This node should be used to implement custom IK solvers, constraints, or skeleton physics.

method.name: _process_modification
method.description: Override this virtual method to implement a custom skeleton modifier. You should do things like get the [Skeleton3D]'s current pose and apply the pose here. [method _process_modification] must not apply [member influence] to bone poses because the [Skeleton3D] automatically applies influence to all bone poses set by the modifier.

method.name: _process_modification_with_delta
method.description: Override this virtual method to implement a custom skeleton modifier. You should do things like get the [Skeleton3D]'s current pose and apply the pose here. [method _process_modification_with_delta] must not apply [member influence] to bone poses because the [Skeleton3D] automatically applies influence to all bone poses set by the modifier. [param delta] is passed from parent [Skeleton3D]. See also [method Skeleton3D.advance]. [b]Note:[/b] This method may be called outside [method Node._process] and [method Node._physics_process] with [param delta] is [code]0.0[/code], since the modification should be processed immediately after initialization of the [Skeleton3D].

method.name: _skeleton_changed
method.description: Called when the skeleton is changed.

method.name: _validate_bone_names
method.description: Called when bone names and indices need to be validated, such as when entering the scene tree or changing skeleton.

method.name: get_modifier_estimated_update_us
method.description: Returns the bounded quarter-weight exponential moving average of this modifier's completed processing time, in microseconds, or 0 if no measurement has been taken. Only [method _process_modification_with_delta] and native [code]_process_modification[/code] work is measured, not the [signal modification_processed] listeners, surrounding [Skeleton3D] processing, [AnimationMixer], or GPU skinning. The average is retained while profiling is disabled to help budget tier-0 IK re-entry.

method.name: get_modifier_last_update_us
method.description: Returns the most recently completed modifier update duration, in microseconds (clamped to 1–100000), or 0 before the first measurement.

method.name: get_modifier_profile_sample_count
method.description: Returns the number of profiled modifier updates, saturated at one million. Updates skipped because [member active] is disabled or the modifier is outside the scene tree are not measured.

method.name: reset_modifier_profile
method.description: Clears this modifier's last duration, average and sample count. Does not change [member modifier_profiling_enabled], its animation state, or its skeleton.

method.name: smooth_modifier_cost_us
method.description: Pure bounded integer sample smoother. The first sample is used unmodified when [param previous_us] is 0; later estimates equal integer division of [code](3 * previous_us + sample_us + 2) / 4[/code]. Valid ranges: previous 0–100000us and sample 1–100000us; invalid inputs return -1. Useful for verifying or reproducing profiling estimates without a running 3D scene.

method.name: get_skeleton
method.description: Returns the parent [Skeleton3D] node if it exists. Otherwise, returns [code]null[/code].

members.member: When enabled, measures each active modifier callback using two microsecond clock reads. Off by default, so unprofiled modifiers pay no clock cost. Applies equally to native and script-defined modifiers. Toggling this property preserves the previous measurement; call [method reset_modifier_profile] to clear it. This is a local CPU work-unit estimate, not a hard deadline or a replacement for a full animation profiler.
Sets the influence of the modification. [b]Note:[/b] This value is used by [Skeleton3D] to blend, so the [SkeletonModifier3D] should always apply only 100% of the result without interpolation.

signal.name: modification_processed
signal.description: Notifies when the modification have been finished. [b]Note:[/b] If you want to get the modified bone pose by the modifier, you must use [method Skeleton3D.get_bone_pose] or [method Skeleton3D.get_bone_global_pose] at the moment this signal is fired.
